text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Trainer, Happy New Year~.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I took great care of you all throughout 
last year. Please let me take care of you 
this year too, okay?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, do you think so? Well, since it's a 
celebratory occasion, I hope you can 
overlook it.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
So right off the bat, would it be alright 
if I shared my resolution for this year?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I want to pamper you lots and lots this 
year, Trainer♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I'd love to take my time with it, but 
truth be told, I just can't wait any 
longer...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Um, so, since it's the New Year, would you 
mind letting me pamper you a little?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Please tell me the wish you want 
fulfilled, okay? I'll make anything come 
true for you.

Rather than a New Year's resolution, this 
ended up feeling more like New Year's 
pocket money...
Now then, what should I wish for?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Oh, a request for something homemade! 
Thank you so much~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
I was thinking the same thing. Since New 
Year's only comes once a year, I wanted to 
feed them something special.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: All right.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Okaaay, it's ready~. Seven-herb ozoni, 
tender black soybeans, plus a Happy New 
Year hamburger steak♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Since we have the chance, may I do *that* 
as well?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: Here, say aaah♪

Every single one was packed with flavor 
and nutrition! Super Creek seemed to 
thoroughly enjoy her meal as well.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Ehh, you're not going to make any request 
of me?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... Fine, then this is a contest of 
endurance. I'm not leaving until you ask 
me to, okay?
And several hours later—

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
*Yaaawn*... Trainer-san... Could you make 
your wish soon...?

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
"Since you've waited this long, didn't it 
make you want to order something?"
choice_data_list: I want to sleep on a lap pillow...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: You finally said it. Here you go~

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text: I can't... anymore either... Ngh...

They fell asleep huddled close together. 
Perhaps due to the warmth, both slept 
soundly.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, understood~. After all, getting 
praised right at the start makes it feel 
like this year will be full of rapid 
growth.

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Well then, here you go. There, there... 
good girl♪

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Huh, what? That light just now...? It felt 
like my hand was glowing a little...

text_block_list.name: Super Creek
text_block_list.text:
Did something happen? Like... a divine 
intervention?

"Ideas are welling up in my head one after 
another. Looks like I'll be able to give 
Super Creek all kinds of technical 
guidance!"
